stack: SGLang main fcb3274646e43c16d70fd83806ebb3a5134d5e81 with serving patches 0001-0004 (stack.lock)
notes: Successor of the op234 runtime (SGLang 0.5.21). op234 values are guidance only; every setting below was re-justified against the pinned SGLang source for this stack. Sources name files under python/sglang/srt at the pinned commit unless they start with http, docs/ or the serving repository.

args.reason: Explicit for a versioned profile; serving patch 0004 supplies dense Quark MXFP4 on gfx1201 without AITER.
Unquantized tensors and activations are BF16 as the checkpoint declares; the gfx1201 MXFP4 path requires BF16 inputs.
Weights plus a 128K-class KV pool do not fit one 32 GB card.
Two full-length conversations fit a 262144-token pool; keeps op234's 32-token near-limit reserve.
Target for two users at full context. It is a cap; the profiled pool may be smaller and the first start must show it fits.
Endurance-tested on these cards in op234; the computed default (~0.81) is tuned for VLM image traffic this deployment does not run. Allowed band 0.90-0.93.
Family workload is one or two users; with speculative decoding the default (48) would size verify buffers, graphs and the mamba cache for 48.
Hybrid GDN decode stalls behind each prefill chunk; 4096 (the 32 GB default) was slower with higher allocator peaks on this hardware.
HIP default without the AITER KV layout; required by arm A's no_buffer and compatible with arm B.
The checkpoint has no KV scales; FP8 KV on the Triton HIP path is unmeasured for head_dim 256 on wave32.
The HIP default is aiter, which is not installed and is a documented failure on R9700; prefill, decode and the DFlash draft follow this value.
args.source: arg_groups/model_override_base.py (get_default_attn_backend); ROCm 10.0 release notes, Radeon known issues

args.reason: The ratio default would give about half of post-weight memory to GDN state; 19 covers two running requests plus cached conversation checkpoints.
Stops one long conversation from holding all 19 mamba slots (op234 cap3).
DFlash2 is the draft trained for this target; op234 measured 6.95/8 greedy and about 4.2 sampled acceptance.
Matches the draft's block_size 8; explicit so a failed inference cannot fall back to 16.
The draft is a BF16 checkpoint; the default inherits the target's quark quantization.

BF16 for bring-up. fp8_e4m3 would save about 1.25 GiB per card and the target still verifies every token, but FP8 draft KV has never been tested here, and FP8 target KV (2026-10-26) passed its answer checks yet ran 5-18% slower on the Triton path. Use FP8 draft KV only if the first start is short of memory, and only after a speed and quality check.
Decode graphs are the main single-user latency win.
Already the HIP default; explicit so the profile does not change if the default flips.
Only batch sizes the two-request limit can produce; fewer captures shorten startup and reserve less memory.
As above; the 32 GB default is 48.

Without AITER, HIP falls back to SGLang's IPC custom all-reduce, which needs P2P and has no RDNA4 release/acquire barrier over non-coherent PCIe; custom AR also diverged TP ranks under speculative decoding upstream. RCCL is the safe path.
The unquantized lm_head produces FP32 logits for verify and sampling; negligible cost at batch 1-2.
Reproducible sampled runs for A/B comparisons.
Separates <think> output for clients.
The chat template emits <tool_call><function=...>; the Hermes parser would not parse it.
SGLang's recommended structured-output backend; outlines is not installed on Python 3.14 (serving patch 0003).
Owner's default request profile, applied server-side with setdefault so per-request values win.
Explicit checkpoint format.
Serial for bring-up; overlap (staging files during graph capture) is a startup-time candidate.
Avoids I/O oversubscription when reading weights over NFS.
Releases about 23 GB of page cache on a 62 GiB host with no swap.
Prometheus /metrics for the workstation telemetry (TTFT, ITL, cache hits, speculative acceptance).
Per-request cached-token counts show multi-turn prefix reuse.
Default cadence; op234's 1 was benchmark logging.

B.reason: First experiment after the arm A baseline (owner decision 2026-11-09). HIP now passes the extra_buffer platform check; extra_buffer_lazy costs 4 mamba slots per request instead of 5, is admitted with DFLASH and keeps the overlap scheduler on, which the 2026-10 host-runtime audit flagged as an unmeasured lead. Unvalidated on gfx1201 wave32.

A.reason: Bring-up baseline (owner decision 2026-11-09): the op234 cache strategy, so the first qualification changes only the stack. no_buffer requires the overlap scheduler off; op234 used it because its image excluded ROCm from extra_buffer.

C.reason: Arm A plus block verification (arXiv 2403.10444, Algorithm 2). For sampled DFLASH proposals it accepts the longest prefix the joint distribution allows rather than deciding token by token, raising the expected accepted length with the output distribution unchanged; greedy requests are unaffected. Not available to op234 (v0.5.21). Costs a residual-mass pass over the vocabulary per candidate prefix, so measure tokens per verify and ms per step against arm A.
C.source: arg_groups/fields/spec.py (speculative_use_block_verification); arg_groups/speculative_hook.py (DFLASH, CUDA or ROCm); speculative/dflash_worker_v2.py:500; speculative/reject_sampling.py

env.name: SGLANG_GFX1201_SPLITK_DOWNOUT
env.reason: op234 S4 split-K for down (5120x8704) and out (5120x3072) MXFP4 GEMMs on M8/M16 verify rows; measured 88 to 67 us (down) and 34 to 30 us (out) per call, bitwise-equal outputs.

D.reason: Arm A plus S4 split-K (0006). Isolates its effect on verify step time; outputs are bitwise equal in the GEMM check, so quality and acceptance should not change.

env.name: SGLANG_GFX1201_PACKED_GDN_IN_PROJ
env.reason: One MXFP4 quantize and GEMM for the 48 GDN QKVZ+BA input projections on M8/M16 rows (op234 operation 164); measured 101 to 76 us (M8), bitwise-equal outputs, no duplicated weights.

E.reason: Arm A plus the packed GDN input projection (0007). Bitwise-exact, so only step time should change.

env.name: SGLANG_GFX1201_FP8_LM_HEAD
env.reason: Block-128 FP8 copy of the LM head for target-verify (8/16 rows, FP32 out) and draft (7/14 rows) logits (op234 D3b); measured 2.04 to 1.12 ms per call. Lossy: about 2% max logit error on random data, so it must pass the bench quality phase.

F.reason: Arm A plus FP8 target and draft heads (0009). The one lossy port: compare quality results and greedy acceptance with arm A before enabling.

G.reason: Arm A plus GDN ReplaySSM for DFLASH (0008): compact replay instead of per-step SSM snapshots (forces --mamba-ssm-dtype float32). Changes state handling, so quality and acceptance must match arm A.

env.name: SGLANG_GFX1201_SPLITK_DOWNOUT
env.reason: op234 S4 split-K for down (5120x8704) and out (5120x3072) MXFP4 GEMMs on M8/M16 verify rows; measured 88 to 67 us (down) and 34 to 30 us (out) per call, bitwise-equal outputs.

env.name: SGLANG_GFX1201_PACKED_GDN_IN_PROJ
env.reason: One MXFP4 quantize and GEMM for the 48 GDN QKVZ+BA input projections on M8/M16 rows (op234 operation 164); measured 101 to 76 us (M8), bitwise-equal outputs, no duplicated weights.

env.name: SGLANG_GFX1201_FP8_LM_HEAD
env.reason: Block-128 FP8 copy of the LM head for target-verify (8/16 rows, FP32 out) and draft (7/14 rows) logits (op234 D3b); measured 2.04 to 1.12 ms per call. Lossy: about 2% max logit error on random data, so it must pass the bench quality phase.

env.name: SGLANG_GFX1201_GDN_NORM_QUANT
env.reason: Fused GDN output gated RMSNorm and MXFP4 quantization for out_proj on 8/16-token rows (op234 F1); measured 54.5 to 21.1 us per layer, packed values and scales bitwise equal to the unfused path.

H.reason: All verify-path ports together (D+E+F+G+I). Candidate default once each part has passed on its own.

env.name: SGLANG_GFX1201_GDN_NORM_QUANT
env.reason: Fused GDN output gated RMSNorm and MXFP4 quantization for out_proj on 8/16-token rows (op234 F1); measured 54.5 to 21.1 us per layer, packed values and scales bitwise equal to the unfused path.

I.reason: Arm A plus the fused GDN gated-norm MXFP4 quantization (0010). Bitwise exact, so only step time should change.

env.name: SGLANG_USE_AITER
env.reason: Matches the default; AITER is not installed.

env.name: SGLANG_USE_AITER_AR
env.reason: Defensive; read only inside custom all-reduce, which is disabled.

env.name: SGLANG_USE_AITER_AG
env.reason: Defensive; the AITER all-gather path defaults on and AITER is absent.

env.name: TORCH_BLAS_PREFER_HIPBLASLT
env.reason: Records PyTorch's gfx1201 default for the remaining BF16 GEMMs (lm_head, draft, vision).

env.reason: Single node.

env.reason: Single node.

env.reason: As above.

toolchain_env.reason: Triton and SGLang JIT need the TheRock SDK inside the image; op234 bound LLVM_PATH to the SDK's LLVM after its sandbox dropped it.

must_unset_env.reason: SDMA-off is a separate diagnostic profile.

must_unset_env.reason: op234 setting; no effect on the DFLASH v2 worker.

must_unset_env.reason: op234 set the undocumented value -1; unset gives the same backend on gfx1201.

not_set.reason: One 262144-token pool copy is about 16 GiB of pinned host memory on a 62 GiB host without swap; the NAS is too slow for an L3 tier.
Startup cost and HIP dynamic-shape gating with no measured benefit.
Unsupported for this architecture; --language-only is the text-only option if images are never needed.
